decision_basis: Every fresh wildcard partition retained every adjacent literal stable ID under strict complete capture. Every wildcard-only record, if any, was reviewed as an intended concept match. All events retained mandatory screenshots.

translation.wildcard_family_atom: NOFT(ordered phrase or token with the smallest bounded [*n]) OR every replaced IF.EXACT literal
translation.wildcard_scope: Every declared variant family with one common source stem. Singleton, punctuation, and unsafe-stem alternatives remain literal.
translation.if_exact_policy: Keep every IF.EXACT literal explicit because NOFT does not cover IF and wildcards inside the exact indexed-term operator are not assumed.

compound_blocks.G_model: G_model_fixed OR G_mission_exact OR (G_mission AND M_B)
compound_blocks.G_structure: G_structure_fixed OR G_product_exact OR G_variation OR (G_product AND M_B)

controls.screenshots: required automatic search-page and results-page PNGs beside every JSON

retained_failure_history.interpretation: Fresh unchanged events completed after each retained failure. No failed attempt contributes a total, stable ID, or translation decision.

retained_screenshots.receipt_boundary: The terminal error artifact has no successful screenshot receipt.
